14. PW 2 Anisur Rahman is a shopkeeper of the Barisal Town and a former Madrasha student of class-V. He stated that in the month of April-May, 2005 he became acquainted with a person named Mehedi in connection with the latter's business in honey, Sometimes they used to have discussion on Islamic matters, Mehedi held out himself to be a member of an Islamic Party and invited PW 2 to go to his (Mehedi's) rented house at Mridha Bari, Rupatali Lal Dighir Par. Accordingly, one day PW 2 went to the house and met Mehedi, Arif, Moaz, Talha, Mahmud and few others. On this occasion there was no meeting. Later on, Mehedi took a loan of Taka 500 from PW 2. So, in the first weeks at October, 2005 PW 2 went to that house in the night to collect the money. But he found nobody there. So he waited upto 10-00 PM when Mehedi and his companions being Moaz, Talha, Mahmud, Arif, Mamun and others came. PW 2 asked for he money but Mehedi requested PW 2 to stay there for some time and to take meal with them and to meet the leaders of their party who were expected to arrive soon. So PW 2 stayed there and at 12-00/12-30 AM five persons arrived. On the query of PW 2, Mehedi disclosed their names as Shaiokh Abdur Rahman, Bangla Bhai, Ataur Rahman Sunny, Abdul Awal and the Barisal Divisional Leader Khaled Saifullah alias Amzad. Thereafter, all of them sat in meeting. A little later another person named Mullah Omar joined them. 

 43. PW 21 Abdus Sattar is a driver of Jhalakati Sadar Hospital who carried the injured Judge Jagannath Pandey to Barisal Medical College Hospital with his ambulance. He stated that after arrival at Barisal Medical College Hospital the Doctors declared Jagannath Pandey dead. On his way back to Jhalakati the police and a Fire Brigade ambulance were standing near the Kalizira Bridge. He stopped his vehicle there and police told him that there was a bomb in the Fire Brigade ambulance and accordingly, injured Badsha and two others were boarded in his ambulance for carrying them to Barisal. So, he again went to Barisal Medical College Hospital with them and came back after dropping them in that hospital. He was not cross-examined.
